title: Steady-State Phase Transition States and Large-Time Asymptotics for the Cauchy Problem of Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations with van der Waals Equation of State
summary: We study the Cauchy problem for the one-dimensional isothermal compressible Navier--Stokes system with the van der Waals equation of state, and analyze the well-posedness and asymptotic stability of steady-state phase-transition solutions at subcritical temperatures. Working in Lagrangian coordinates, we use variational techniques to construct piecewise smooth steady-state solutions corresponding to two-phase equilibrium states under finite-mass perturbations.
